app.name: Openbeehive
app.offline_banner: Offline: changes are saved and synced later.

qr.offline_text: This hive has not been downloaded to this device yet. Connect to the internet and it opens as soon as your data has synced.
qr.missing_title: This hive is not in your data
qr.missing_text: Everything is synced, but this hive is not part of the workspace you are in. It may belong to another workspace (switch in Settings), have been deleted, or be someone else's hive.
qr.signed_out_title: Sign in to open this hive
qr.signed_out_text: This browser is not signed in to Openbeehive, so it has none of your hives yet. Sign in and the hive opens once your data has synced.
qr.unreachable_text: The hive is not on this device and the server did not answer, so it could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
qr.installed_hint: Using the installed app? The phone's camera opens labels in the browser, which keeps its own separate data. Open Openbeehive from your home screen and use Scan there.

scan.aim: Aim at the hive's QR code
scan.title: Scan a hive label
scan.not_hive: That is not an Openbeehive hive label.
scan.hard_to_read: Can't read it? Move closer, hold steady and avoid glare — or type the code printed under the QR code.
scan.denied_text: Allow camera access for Openbeehive in your browser or system settings, then try again.
scan.nocamera_text: This device has no camera the app can use. Type the code printed under the QR code instead.
scan.failed_title: The camera could not be started
scan.failed_text: Another app may be using it. Close that app and try again.
scan.code_help: Label unreadable? Type the six characters printed under the QR code.
scan.code_unknown: No hive with this code on this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_help: Choose the language for the app. Your choice is saved on this device.

auth.name: Name
auth.have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.verify_sent: We've sent you a link to confirm your email. Open it to finish signing up.
auth.verified_ok: Email verified — you can sign in now.
auth.err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.invite_only_banner: This instance is invite-only. Registration is disabled — sign in with an existing account or use your invite link.
auth.invited_banner: You've been invited. Create your account below — or sign in if you already have one.

demo.banner: You're exploring the Openbeehive demo — data resets every hour.

tenant.title: Tenants
tenant.help: Switch between your apiary collections, or create a new one (e.g. a club).
tenant.invite_sent: Invite link created — share it with them.
tenant.delete_help: Deletes this tenant with all its apiaries, hives and records — for every member. This cannot be undone.
tenant.delete_confirm: Delete tenant “{name}” and all its data permanently? This affects every member and cannot be undone.

data.title: Data & backup
data.export_help: Download all your data — keep a backup, move to another instance, or open it in a spreadsheet.
data.import_help: Restore an Openbeehive backup, or migrate from another beekeeping app (CSV) or a BeeXML file.

dashboard.subtitle: Your bee year at a glance.
dashboard.all_current: All up to date — well done!

apiaries.title: Apiaries
apiaries.empty: No apiaries yet. Create your first one.
apiaries.name: Name
apiaries.no_hives: No hives at this apiary yet.
apiaries.map_hint: Type an address or drag the pin — position and address stay in sync.
apiaries.confirm_delete: Delete apiary “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
apiaries.delete_blocked: “{name}” still has {n, plural, one {# hive} other {# hives}}. Move or delete {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} first, then delete the apiary.
apiaries.deleted_text: {n, plural, one {# hive still belongs} other {# hives still belong}} to it. Open {n, plural, one {the hive} other {each hive}} and move it to another apiary.

hives.title: Hives
hives.empty: No hives yet. Add one to an apiary.
hives.name: Name
hives.confirm_delete: Delete hive “{name}” with all its records? This cannot be undone.
hives.move_none: There is no other apiary to move this hive to.

queens.title: Queen
queens.edit_hint: Correct her details here. For a new queen, use “Replace queen” instead.
queens.confirm_delete: Delete queen {year}? Do this only for a queen recorded by mistake: if she is the current queen, her predecessor becomes current again.

insp.varroa_hint: Mites per day. Plain numbers appear in the charts.

stats.title: Development
stats.no_data: No recorded data yet — log a few visits to see trends.
stats.varroa_skipped: {n, plural, one {# entry is not a plain number and is not charted.} other {# entries are not plain numbers and are not charted.}}

harvest.title: Honey
harvest.confirm_delete: Delete the harvest of {amount} kg from {date}?

treat.title: Treatments
treat.print_blocked: The print window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

common.confirm_delete: Delete this? This cannot be undone.
common.volatile_store: Storage is unavailable — changes will not persist on this device.

pk.title: Passkeys
pk.help: Sign in without a password using Face ID, fingerprint or a security key. A passkey is bound to this account and stored on your device.
pk.delete_confirm: Remove this passkey? You can no longer sign in with it.
pk.not_supported: This browser does not support passkeys.

apikeys.title: API keys
apikeys.help: Keys let scripts and devices, such as a hive scale, use the API as you in this tenant. Create one per device and remove it when the device is retired.
apikeys.delete_confirm: Remove this key? Scripts using it stop working immediately.
apikeys.new_help: Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
apikeys.tenant_help: As tenant admin you can remove any member's key, for example when someone leaves or a device is lost.
apikeys.delete_theirs_confirm: Remove this member's key? Their scripts using it stop working immediately.

geo.not_found: No match for this address — drop the pin on the map instead.
geo.unreachable: Address search is unavailable right now — check your connection or drop the pin on the map.
